       o.order_id, o.order_date, o.amount_eur, o.order_status
FROM demo.semantic_interop.sessions AS s
LEFT JOIN demo.semantic_interop.orders AS o
  ON s.session_id = o.session_id

WHERE s.session_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND s.session_date < DATE '2026-03-01'
) authored_source WHERE is_eligible = true

dax.Eligible Sessions:
COALESCE(
    CALCULATE(
        DISTINCTCOUNT(Sessions[session_id]),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[is_eligible] = TRUE()),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] >= DATE(2026, 1, 1)),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1))
    ),
    0
)
dax.Converted Sessions:
COALESCE(
    CALCULATE(
        DISTINCTCOUNT(Orders[session_id]),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[is_eligible] = TRUE()),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] >= DATE(2026, 1, 1)),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1)),
        KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_status] = "paid"),
        KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1))
    ),
    0
)
dax.Paid Revenue:
CALCULATE(
    SUM(Orders[amount_eur]),
    KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[is_eligible] = TRUE()),
    KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] >= DATE(2026, 1, 1)),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1)),
    KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_status] = "paid"),
    KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1))
)
